purpose: Estimate A0/B0 baseline repeatability and a planning detection-capability frontier for the v3.72 dual-path stress-tomography experiment before A2/B2 unblinding. This contract does not create a physical pass threshold from synthetic data.

arms.A0: eC9 donor-free baseline control; electrical interpretation requires the v3.70/v3.71 architecture gate

stress_axes.T: dark thermal morphology stress; planning precedent 85 C, dark, inert atmosphere
stress_axes.L: illuminated operational stress; planning precedent approximately 1 sun, MPP tracking, controlled device temperature

primary_analysis_unit: fabrication-lot mean log retention after collapsing substrate-level summaries; technical repeats never increase independent N

equations.cell_repeatability: s_cell = sample SD of independent lot means

planning_assumptions.important_boundary: The MDE frontier is a sensitivity/planning calculation, not a guaranteed power statement. Treatment-arm variance and covariance are unknown until A2/B2 data exist.

fail_closed_rules: Return INCOMPLETE if fewer than 3 independent fabrication lots exist in any A0/B0 x T/L cell.
Return INCOMPLETE if the A0 electrical architecture lacks film-integrity qualification.
Return INCOMPLETE if calibration metadata, stress-history matching, contact control, or optical control is missing/failing.
Return INCOMPLETE if positive before/after values are absent or duplicate independent keys exist.
Do not select a physical Psi/Omega pass threshold from the synthetic fixture or from the MDE frontier alone.
Do not unblind A2/B2 until the physical decision margin, stress checkpoints, exclusions, and required N are frozen from baseline capability plus useful-work relevance.

source_provenance.source: Reese et al., Consensus stability testing protocols for organic photovoltaic materials and devices, Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells 95 (2011)
source_provenance.used_for: separation and reporting of dark/thermal/light stress classes; research protocol framing rather than product qualification

source_provenance.source: NIST TN 1297 terminology and NIST/SEMATECH measurement process characterization
source_provenance.used_for: explicit distinction among repeatability, reproducibility, stability, and uncertainty; characterize the measurement process before interpreting treatment effects

next_physical_step: Run A0 and B0 only through T and L with real calibration/stress-history metadata; freeze a useful-work-relevant physical margin and required lot count before A2/B2 labels are unblinded.
